The ruler of [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]], [[Tirgee Benyalle]], owned and operated a '''luxury sail barge''' during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], it was used to hold a meeting between Benyalle, [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Uther Kermen]], [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Talon Karrde|Pandis Hart]], and a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] delegation over the rights to harvest food from Kaal's oceans.
